tasks.label: Check Node install
args: Write-Output 'task-runner-ok'; Get-Command node,npm,winget,curl.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source

tasks.label: Download verified Node runtime
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $version='v22.12.0'; $base="https://nodejs.org/dist/$version"; $archive=Join-Path $env:TEMP "node-$version-win-x64.zip"; $checksums=Join-Path $env:TEMP "node-$version-SHASUMS256.txt"; curl.exe -fL "$base/node-$version-win-x64.zip" -o $archive; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Node archive download failed' }; curl.exe -fL "$base/SHASUMS256.txt" -o $checksums; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Node checksum download failed' }; $line=Select-String -Path $checksums -Pattern "node-$version-win-x64.zip\s*$" | Select-Object -First 1; $expected=($line.Line -split '\s+')[0]; $actual=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw "Node archive SHA-256 mismatch: expected $expected, got $actual" }; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $env:TEMP -Force; $install=Join-Path $env:TEMP "node-$version-win-x64"; & (Join-Path $install 'node.exe') --version; & (Join-Path $install 'npm.cmd') --version

tasks.label: Inspect Node artifacts
args: Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP -Filter 'node-v22.12.0*' | Select-Object Name,Length; Get-Process curl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,CPU,StartTime

tasks.label: Verify Node MSI
args:
Select-String -Path "$env:TEMP
ode-v22.12.0-SHASUMS256.txt" -Pattern 'node-v22.12.0-x64.msi'; Get-AuthenticodeSignature "$env:TEMP
ode-v22.12.0-x64.msi" | Select-Object Status,StatusMessage,SignerCertificate; Get-Item "$env:TEMP
ode-v22.12.0-x64.msi" | Select-Object Length,LastWriteTime

tasks.label: Verify Node MSI checksum
args: $sumFile=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'node-v22.12.0-SHASUMS256.txt'; $msi=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'node-v22.12.0-x64.msi'; $entry=Get-Content $sumFile | Where-Object { $_.EndsWith('node-v22.12.0-x64.msi') } | Select-Object -First 1; $expected=$entry.Substring(0,64); $actual=(Get-FileHash $msi -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); Write-Output "Expected: $expected"; Write-Output "Actual:   $actual"; if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw 'MSI checksum mismatch' }
